unit: Round 1 - quick fixes (plan step 0) and the locked IA (owner steps 1 and 3)

device.install: adb install -r (sign-in kept, no uninstall, no data clear)

walk: Read-only. Nothing was typed, sent, saved or rated; Poruke was not opened; no Objavi zadatak conversation was started.

checked.result: tabs Početna | Zadaci | Dogovori with the new home icon; two tiles; Čeka te with the unrated Dogovori; Moji zadaci and Moje prijave rows with counts; no greeting or tagline for a returning user
one screen for map and list (Lista / Mapa), search, filters and the orange add action in one row, own tasks hidden with a Prikaži line
uskociapp://mapa and uskociapp://prilike open Zadaci; Back from Zadaci returns to Početna
a finished unrated Dogovor shows one green Oceni saradnju; the calendar button in the tab header
seven columns fit at 411 dp, the day is selected, the empty day states its scope
HH:MM week, Po vremenu u Srbiji, disabled save until something changes
Početna at 320, 360, 390 and 430 dp and at font scale 1.3; Zadaci at 360 dp and font 1.3 (sheet R1_WIDTHS_AND_TEXT.png)

defectsFound.what: Android reports its Large text setting as 1.2999999523 (a float), so layouts keyed on fontScale >= 1.3 (Početna tiles, the candidate comparison columns) do not switch at that setting; at 360 dp the side-by-side tiles wrap to four lines
defectsFound.fix: compare a rounded scale; scheduled with the round-2 integration

defectsFound.what: the retired Moje aktivnosti screen has no entry left but still opens from a deep link
defectsFound.fix: redirect it to Početna like /mapa and /prilike

defectsFound.what: a Dogovor finished earlier the same day is not in the calendar and the empty day says you do not work that day
defectsFound.fix: owner step 10 (calendar): show finished work of the day quietly or word the empty day as open commitments

notDone: Map and list redesign (owner step 4), card system (step 5), Dogovori list wrapping of the time, availability orientation sentence; these belong to their own steps. Critique by separate UX and visual critics is recorded in the round-1 critique notes when it returns.
